questions.stem: When decane (C10H22) is cracked to produce octane (C8H18) and one other product, what is that other product?
questions.explanation: Balancing the equation: C10H22 -> C8H18 + ? The missing product needs 10-8 = 2 carbons and 22-18 = 4 hydrogens, giving C2H4 (ethene). Cracking always produces at least one alkene. Ethene is particularly valuable for making polymers like poly(ethene).
